renderer.ownership: Server-side NVIDIA runtime owns USD stage loading, renderer.step(), camera/session layers, native picking, selection writes, and live USD mutations.

transport.readiness_rule: A /healthz-style ready signal must mean the ovrtx server produced and copied the first valid RTX frame into the ovstream buffer; browser connection alone is not readiness.

runtime_gates.evidence_required: nvidia-smi output from the GPU host

runtime_gates.required_for: ovrtx/Kit stage loading and RTX frame production
runtime_gates.evidence_required: ovrtx/Kit process log plus first-frame readiness evidence
ovstream import/lifecycle check, signaling URL, and browser video first-frame capture

browser_client_contract.allowed_render_surface: HTML video element displaying the ovstream WebRTC media track with object-fit: contain

data_channel_messages.payload: server frame readiness and stage metadata
named camera preset or orbital camera intent; server applies it in session state
semantic layer id and visibility boolean; server mutates session/composite layer only
native picking result, prim path, and display metadata
requested AOV/render mode; server validates and applies

browser_client_contract.input_routing: Mouse, keyboard, wheel, and touch input must use NVIDIA native streaming input forwarding where available; do not invent JSON mouse events for USD picking.

validation_artifacts_to_attach: browser video first-frame screenshot or stream capture
updated nvidia_runtime_preflight.json from the GPU host
